caption: Pozzo di San Patrizio, Orvieto
composition: Looking down the Renaissance double-helix well shaft with arched openings · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks straight down the well's brick throat, the twin spiral ramps winding past tier after tier of arched windows that admit shafts of daylight. The circles of masonry shrink toward the dark water far below at the center. At 11:51 the sun reaches deep into the shaft, and the geometry of the double helix is the whole picture — a vertiginous stone funnel.
